lines.not_deep: A little deeper, if it's comfortable.
lines.not_upright: Stand up tall at the top.
lines.uses_hands: Cross your arms, and stand up without pushing.
lines.not_straight: Straighten your knee a bit more.
lines.no_hold: Hold it straight for two seconds.
lines.not_high: Lift a little higher, to shoulder height.
lines.steady: Nice effort. Make the next one slow and steady.
lines.start_squat: Camera's ready. Let's do the chair squat. Take your time.
lines.start_sit_to_stand: Camera's ready. Let's do sit to stand. Take your time.
lines.start_arm_raise: Camera's ready. Let's do the arm raise, out to the side. Take your time.
lines.set_done: That's the set. Take a breather, then carry on.
lines.all_done: Nice work. That's all of them.
lines.setup_find_you: I can't see you yet. Stand in front of the camera.
lines.setup_step_back: Step back a little. I need to see you from your shoulders down to your knees.
lines.setup_step_back_arm: Step back a little, so I can see your arms and your hips.
lines.setup_hold: That's it. Hold still for a second.
lines.fall_check: Are you okay? It looks like you went down.
lines.ask_help: Tell me you're okay, or tap a button. I can call nine one one, or your emergency contact.
lines.tap_911: Tap the red button to call nine one one.
lines.tap_contact: Tap the button to call your emergency contact.
lines.glad_ok: Glad you're okay. Take your time, then carry on.
lines.pain_stop: Let's stop here. I've told your physiotherapist.
lines.not_counted_squat: That one didn't count. Go lower, sit back toward the chair.
lines.not_counted_sit_to_stand: That one didn't count. Sit all the way down, then stand up.
lines.not_counted_arm_raise: That one didn't count. Lift your arm higher, up to your shoulder.
